title: mentha viridis subsp. angustifolia
intro: Mentha viridis subsp. angustifolia, commonly known as Spearmint, is a subspecies of the peppermint plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This herb is prized for its potential health benefits, which include relieving digestive issues, reducing nausea and headaches, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Spearmint can be attributed to its ability to relax muscles, ease respiratory issues, and provide a calming effect on the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of Spearmint include menthone, limonene, and carvone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
